Hi! This is my first Mathlib PR: [(https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/42345)]. It proves a characterization of continuous one-parameter subgroups of the units of a real Banach algebra, and I’d especially appreciate feedback on the public API and whether the module placement seems appropriate. In particular, would reviewers prefer the fully generic class-based signature
[FunLike F (Multiplicative ℝ) Eˣ] [MonoidHomClass F (Multiplicative ℝ) Eˣ] [ContinuousMapClass F (Multiplicative ℝ) Eˣ]
over the simpler
ContinuousMonoidHom (Multiplicative ℝ) Eˣ?
I also want to note that substantial LLM assistance was used during development, and the PR is labelled accordingly.

In particular, would reviewers prefer the fully generic class-based signature
[FunLike F (Multiplicative ℝ) Eˣ] [MonoidHomClass F (Multiplicative ℝ) Eˣ] [ContinuousMapClass F (Multiplicative ℝ) Eˣ]
over the simpler
ContinuousMonoidHom (Multiplicative ℝ) Eˣ?

If the *Hom appears as a parameter of a non-theorem def, it should be the concrete type like ContinuousMonoidHom. Otherwise it can use *HomClass

Also I think AddChar A B is preferred over MonoidHom (Multiplicative A) B
Edit: oh but it doesn't have the continuous version...
